hero.h1: Catch Basin Cleaning and Repair in Hinsdale, IL
hero.sub: Water that sits on the driveway, a grate lost under a carpet of leaves or a low spot that turns into a pond after every storm. We clean and repair catch basins and clear the lines they drain into. Our office is on Spinning Wheel Road.

img.alt: Cast iron catch basin grate at the edge of an asphalt driveway, partly covered with fallen leaves next to a landscaped garden bed

trust: 4.7 stars · 5,669+ Google reviews across all locations

blocks.body: A catch basin is a small chamber under a grate that collects runoff from the yard, the driveway or the downspouts and sends it into a drain line. The bottom of the chamber sits lower than the outlet pipe, so leaves and silt can settle out first. Once that space fills, the debris flows into the outlet, the line clogs and the water has nowhere to go but across the surface.

img.alt: Diagram of a catch basin showing the inlet grate, water line, sediment settling in the sump and the outlet pipe carrying water away

items.h3: Brick and Block Basins From Decades Ago
items.body: They crack, settle and lose mortar over time.
Driveway basins collect grit and salt every winter.
When a heavy storm hits, a blocked basin turns runoff into standing water against the foundation.

blocks.h2: Catch Basin Questions From Hinsdale Homeowners

items.q: How often should a catch basin be cleaned?
items.preview: Once a year after leaf drop, more with big trees.
items.answer: At least once a year, usually after the leaves come down. Properties with big trees overhead may need a spring cleaning too.

items.q: Can a blocked catch basin cause water in the basement?
items.answer: Yes. Water pooled near the foundation soaks into the soil and finds its way into older basements or your [sump pump](/hinsdale/sump-pumps) pit.

items.q: Is the catch basin in my yard my responsibility?
items.preview: Usually, if it drains your property.
items.answer: Usually. If it's on your property and handles your yard or driveway, maintaining it is up to you.

items.q: Can you rebuild an old brick catch basin?
items.answer: Often. We can rebuild walls, reset the frame and replace the grate. If it's too far gone, we'll recommend a replacement.

items.q: How much does catch basin repair cost in Hinsdale?
items.preview: It depends on the work. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether it needs cleaning, a grate, wall repair or outlet work. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
